structs.notes: Size 37848 is proven by method 2 with the vtable check done: the destructor at 0x140C9E6C0 is slot 0 of BgAntiLag_vftable (0x1423BD2D0), which BgAntiLag::BgAntiLag stores, and it frees 37848. The game-test m_refCountDebugStack (8192 bytes at GT 26220) is absent in Replay: m_prevFrame is at 26224 (GT 34416), the lerp array at 26232 (GT 34424), and every later member is exactly 8192 lower; no string 'Antilag stack depth' and no AddRefCountDebugItem / PrintRefCountAssertInfo function exists in Replay. IDA's layout is already right through +37840; only the size and the invented tail after +37844 are wrong. The three UNCONFIRMED names come from game-test and conflict with the AddPendingEntryPair callers; the coordinator should decide them. CgAntiLag_ctor@0x141673080 calls BgAntiLag::BgAntiLag on the same pointer (base at 0) and writes its own members from +144344, which agrees with a 37848-byte base but does not prove it.
